From 1231-09-17 back 345 - 365 = -20? That’s wrong because 345 < 365.

July has 31, back 31 → 1232-06-30 (297-31=266).

April 30 → 1232-03-31 (205-30=175).  
March 31 → 1232-02-29 (175-31=144) (1232 is leap year).  
February 29 → 1232-01-31 (144-29=115).  
January 31 → 1231-12-31 (115-31=84).  
December 31 → 1231-11-30 (84-31=53).  
November 30 → 1231-10-31 (53-30=23).  
October 31 → 1231-09-30 (23-31 = -8) → mistake, because 23 < 31, so stop at October.
